name: temple_stairs
description: Generic stone temple-stairs backdrop for the macaque item: stone paving foreground (y -120..0), a full-width flat stone balustrade wall with block lines and a light coping whose flat top surface is at y -300 (macaques sit there), wide tapered stone steps (x -350..350 at y -300 up to y -620) between side ramp walls, a shadowed porch with red-brown pillars and dark terracotta roof eaves (x -500..500, top y -700), green bushes at both sides. No religious symbols, no text; sky comes from the shotlist. Bottom-centre anchor, 1920x700.
